defects.what: A kelp tip touches a heavy wave curl, making separate motifs look accidentally joined.
Several dots collide with shell edges and fronds rather than occupying the negative space.
Large wave and shell are awkwardly cut by the label boundary.

KVXZ.craft_notes: Specific kelp and detailed shell drawing, but heavy curls and repeated tangencies weaken the pattern. All ten round-1 views inspected. Exact repeated raster preview, appropriate sizes and 300dpi confirmed.
KVXZ.revision_notes: All shells become amber and motif/dot count drops roughly one third; all files regenerated. Retained motifs are also substantially repositioned, rotated and resized, beyond merely reducing their number.

defects.what: Crossing coloured lines form tangled loops that read more like bird heads than curling waves.
Dots and partial shells touch the label outline, making its edge feel cluttered.

ONSJ.craft_notes: Light, evenly distributed repeat with good size and rotation variation. Shells are readable, but kelp looks like generic leafy sprigs. All ten round-1 views inspected; seam crops are continuous. Preview matches repeated tile aside from tiny rasterization differences.
ONSJ.revision_notes: Amber shells and approximately one-third fewer motif groups/dots across regenerated files. Existing waves and shells also move or change orientation; this introduces unnecessary composition drift.

defects.what: A frond and partial shell emerge from the corners, creating avoidable tangencies.

VIGE.craft_notes: Clean rounded motif drawing, balanced colour accents and a refined double-rule label. Kelp is somewhat generic, but the visual system is coherent. All ten round-1 views inspected and raster preview is an exact 3x3 repetition; no visible seam breaks.
VIGE.revision_notes: Shells are amber and the regenerated pattern has roughly one-third fewer marks (303 to 197 SVG paths). However many retained motifs are reshaped, rotated or repositioned, so the revision changes more than colour and density.

pairwise_round1.why: KVXZ's more specific kelp and shell illustrations outweigh its less controlled spacing.
VIGE balances motif weights more evenly and has cleaner spacing and label treatment.
VIGE's simple readable curls and shells form a more coherent pattern than ONSJ's tangled wave lines.
